# serverguard24_groups (Data Source)

Retrieves all available Serverguard24 host groups.

~> **Status unknown:** The groups feature appears to have no UI and no API commands to create or manage groups. `get_groups` consistently returns an empty list on all known accounts. This data source is kept for completeness but may not be functional.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "serverguard24_groups" "all" {}

output "groups" {
  value = data.serverguard24_groups.all.groups
}

output "by_name" {
  value = data.serverguard24_groups.all.by_name
}
```
